notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.5
notes.content: [p]Our first patch is live! 🎉 The demo launch went super smooth, no game-breaking bugs in sight! This update is all about small fixes and improvements. Thanks to all players for jumping in and sharing feedback! ⭐[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changed:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Quickreplay cannot be used during sequences or in option screens (to prevent unexpected behaviour),[/p][/*][*][p]Challenges now indicate if the level can be completed with less shoes or if the challenge is exactly the lowest possible shoecount,[/p][/*][*][p]Shoe count bubble showing the combined sum of all shoes on the pile and on the feet,[/p][/*][*][p]Campfire to be easier to hit,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Fixed:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Quickreplay sometimes showing success phrase,[/p][/*][*][p]Quickreplay not resetting timer,[/p][/*][*][p]Shoes not counting as hit if the same shoe touched ground in the last round,[/p][/*][*][p]Shoe count bubble showing up during success overlay,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved shoe pooling to improve performance on low end devices,[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where lace did not despawn after the level has ended,[/p][/*][*][p]Timer starting at level load not when level has finished spawning,[/p][/*][*][p]Successtext being cut off mid word,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved loading times for menu/journal scene[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Shoes not counting as hit if the same shoe touched ground in the last round,
- Shoe count bubble showing up during success overlay,
- Improved shoe pooling to improve performance on low end devices,
- Bug where lace did not despawn after the level has ended,
- Timer starting at level load not when level has finished spawning,
- Successtext being cut off mid word,

tags.balance_change: - Quickreplay cannot be used during sequences or in option screens (to prevent unexpected behaviour),
- Challenges now indicate if the level can be completed with less shoes or if the challenge is exactly the lowest possible shoecount,
- Shoe count bubble showing the combined sum of all shoes on the pile and on the feet,
- Campfire to be easier to hit,

tags.feature: - Improved loading times for menu/journal scene
